basic_info.description: Welcome to this inviting two-bedroom, two-bath home in Ingleside Heights, offering stunning views and a fantastic investment opportunity for the discerning buyer seeking a property in a prime location. The main level features a formal living and dining area with a cozy fireplace, an eat-in kitchen, and expansive windows that frame breathtaking views and fill the space with abundant natural light. Two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath complete this level. The lower level boasts a flexible layout, including an additional bedroom or entertainment room, a second bathroom, and direct access to the private yard  ideal for relaxation or entertaining. A spacious garage with ample storage and a convenient parking pad enhances the home's functionality. Don't miss this rare chance to own a single-family home with sweeping views, conveniently located near shopping, public transportation, restaurants, cafes, parks, and easy access to HWY 101 and 280!
